original_question: Josh na-ekpebi ireghari ụlọ. Ọ na-azụta ụlọ n'ọnụ ego $80,000 ma tinye $55,000 n'imezi ya. Nke a buliri ọnụ ego ụlọ ahụ ihe dịka 150%. Uru ego ole ka ọ ga-erita?
question_template: {name_male, Josh} na-ekpebi ireghari ụlọ. Ọ zụtara ụlọ n'ọnụ ego ${num_digit_1, 80,000} ma tinye ${num_digit_2, 50,000} n'imezi ya. Nke a buliri ọnụ ego ụlọ ahụ ihe dịka {num_digit_3, 150}%. Uru ego ole ka o ritere?
question_solution: new_value = num_digit_1 + (num_digit_1 * num_digit_3 / 100); total_investment = num_digit_1 + num_digit_2; answer = new_value - total_investment
